name: Canta-me uma História – ao vivo
description: Canta-me uma História – Ao Vivo is a podcast brought to the stage, celebrating creativity, Portuguese humor, and touching stories. David Antunes, accompanied by Emanuel Moura, Carolina Ligeiro, and special guests, invites attendees to a memorable night.
longDescription:
Canta-me uma História – Ao Vivo is presented as more than just a podcast transported to the stage; it is a celebration of creativity, Portuguese humor, and stories that resonate with the audience. The event features David Antunes, joined by Emanuel Moura, Carolina Ligeiro, and various special guests.

The performance is scheduled for November 7 at 21:30, taking place at the Super Bock Arena Porto. Tickets are priced between 20€ and 30€. The event is categorized under Concerts, Portuguese, and Stand-up comedy, with a classification of M/06.

Doors open at 20:30, with specific entry points for different seating areas: Porta 1 for Camarotes, Portas 2 and 3 for Plateias, and Portas 8 and 9 for Balcões. The duration of the event is 120 minutes.
